topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I just can't believe this happened. I planned everything so carefully, down to the last minute. I was supposed to be there, to see the smile on their face, to share that moment. Now, I'm stuck here, in this crowded airport, watching the minutes tick by, knowing I'm missing something significant. I should have chosen an earlier flight, allowed more time. Now, all I can do is imagine what's happening there without me. It's eating at me, this sense of loss and the weight of what I've missed. I'll apologize and try to make it right, but it won't be the same.
